title: Go访问日志项目：真实流式Flush与HTTP/1连接接管
body:
## 操作任务
提交task.go，实现Wrap(next http.Handler,report func(status,bytes int)) http.Handler。真实转发Header/WriteHeader/Write，记录首次状态、实际写入字节数，隐式写入或Flush对应200，重复WriteHeader不重复转发；handler结束或panic传播时report恰好一次。仅当底层实现Flusher或Hijacker时，包装器分别暴露同一能力，不能伪造能力；支持两者时都需保留。Hijack在未写HTTP响应前成功时报告status=0、bytes=0，由接管方负责原始连接。这里限定Flusher和Hijacker，不承诺Pusher、ReaderFrom或http.ResponseController额外接口。

## 提交产物
task.go

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
真实Go HTTP/1回环服务器：handler仍阻塞时客户端已读到Flush后的首个流式分块；另一个真实TCP请求成功Hijack并收到101和接管数据。覆盖四种底层接口组合、短写、隐式200和重复状态；不声称HTTP/2支持Hijack，也不宣称其他可选接口透明或生产链路已验收。普通student、自有端口、离线标准库，无镜像构建。

test_files.checks/check.py:
import os,pathlib,subprocess,sys,tempfile
assert os.getuid()==1000
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:transparent_http_writer_capabilities',flush=True)
env={**os.environ,'GOCACHE':'/tmp/opsforge-go-cache','GOMODCACHE':'/tmp/opsforge-go-modcache','GOTOOLCHAIN':'local','GOPROXY':'off','GOSUMDB':'off','CGO_ENABLED':'0','GOMAXPROCS':'2','GOMEMLIMIT':'384MiB'}
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='opsforge-go-http-') as name:
 root=pathlib.Path(name);(root/'go.mod').write_text('module opsforge.local/exercise\n\ngo 1.23\n');(root/'task.go').write_bytes(pathlib.Path('task.go').read_bytes());(root/'task_test.go').write_bytes(pathlib.Path('checks/task_test.go').read_bytes())
 p=subprocess.run(['go','test','-vet=off','-v','-count=1','-timeout=8s','./...'],cwd=root,env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=55);assert p.returncode==0,p.stdout+p.stderr
 assert 'NATIVE_GO_HTTP_REAL_FLUSH_BEFORE_HANDLER_RELEASE_AND_HTTP1_HIJACK_SUCCESS' in p.stdout
 print('NATIVE_GO_HTTP_REAL_FLUSH_BEFORE_HANDLER_RELEASE_AND_HTTP1_HIJACK_SUCCESS',flush=True)
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
